metadata.title: One Minhaj — Platform Foundation
metadata.description: Repository and tooling foundation for the One Minhaj digital platform.

foundation.heading: One Minhaj
foundation.intro: Repository and tooling foundation. The platform architecture is recorded in the project documentation; no domain functionality is implemented yet.

common.name: Name
common.checkFields: Check the details you entered and try again.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
common.unavailable: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.

confirmChange.title: Confirm your new email address
confirmChange.description: Confirm that {email} is yours. Your other devices will be signed out.
confirmChange.done: Your email address has been changed.
confirmChange.invalid: This link is no longer usable. Request the change again from your security settings.
confirmChange.needSignIn: Sign in to the account you are changing, then open this link again.

denied.signedOut: You need to sign in to see this.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email address and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.submitted: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.

language.title: Language and time zone
language.description: The language this site uses for you, and the time zone your dates are shown in.

my.title: My Minhaj
my.description: Your account. More will appear here as the platform grows.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How your account is shown to you. This is not a public profile.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in with it now.
reset.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
reset.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.

security.title: Security
security.description: Your password, your active sessions and your account.
security.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Other devices were signed out.
security.passwordWrong: That current password is not right.
security.changeEmailHelp: We will send a link to the new address to confirm it.
security.emailSubmitted: If that address can be used, a confirmation link is on its way.
security.sessionsHelp: Where your account is signed in. Sign out anywhere you do not recognise.
security.methodsHelp: How you sign in. More options will be added later.
security.methodFinal: This is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be removed.
security.closeHelp: Closing removes your sign-in details and signs you out everywhere. Your email address becomes free to use again, and a new account made with it starts from nothing.
security.closeConfirm: Enter your password to close the account
security.twoFactorHelp: An authenticator app produces a short code that changes every thirty seconds. It is required before any administrative capability can be used.
security.stateEnrolled: Two-step verification is on, and your recovery codes are saved.
security.stateIncomplete: Two-step verification is set up, but you have not confirmed that you saved your recovery codes. Administrative capabilities stay unavailable until you do.
security.stateReenrol: Two-step verification was reset by an operator. Set it up again to restore administrative capabilities.
security.enrolIntro: Enter your password to begin. You will be shown a setup key and a set of recovery codes.
security.enrolUriHelp: Add this to your authenticator app. It is shown once.
security.enrolCodesHelp: Save these somewhere safe. Each one works once, and they are shown only now.
security.verifyHelp: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to finish.
security.regenerateHelp: A new set is issued and every unused code from the old set stops working. You will need to confirm the new set.
security.disableHelp: Requires your password and either a current code or one recovery code. If you have lost both, an operator must run the audited recovery procedure.
security.disabled: Two-step verification is off, and every device was signed out.
security.notEnrolled: Two-step verification is not set up on this account.
security.alreadyEnrolled: Two-step verification is already set up.

setup.title: Finish setting up
setup.description: Choose the language and time zone for your account. You can change both later.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to your Minhaj account. The rest of the site is open to everyone without one.
signIn.failed: Those details did not match an account.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: An account saves your place and lets you take part. Reading, searching and listening need no account.
signUp.submitted: Check your email for a link to confirm your address.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.description: Confirm this address to finish setting up your account.
verify.done: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.invalid: This link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
verify.expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
verify.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a link is on its way.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Your password was accepted. Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
twoFactor.codeHelp: Six digits, from the app you set up.
twoFactor.failed: That code was not accepted. Check the app and try again.
twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of the single-use codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works once.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Identity, access and platform operations. Every action is checked on the server and recorded.

common.more: More rows exist than are shown here. Narrow the filter to see them.

denied.noPermission: You do not have the permission this action requires.
denied.secondFactorRequired: Set up two-step verification and confirm your recovery codes before using this.
denied.stepUpRequired: Confirm it is you before making this change.
denied.selfElevation: You cannot change your own privileges. Ask another administrator.
denied.finalAdministrator: This is the last Platform Administrator. Grant the role to someone else first.
denied.protectedRole: Protected system roles cannot be changed here.
denied.duplicateKey: A role with that key already exists.
denied.unknownPermission: That permission is not in the catalogue.
denied.ineligibleTarget: That account is not eligible to hold this role.
denied.invalidInput: Check the values and try again.
denied.unavailable: That did not work. Try again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: Administrative changes need recent proof. Enter your password, and the current code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.codeHelp: Required because two-step verification is on for this account.
stepUp.granted: Confirmed. You can make administrative changes for the next few minutes.
stepUp.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

users.title: Accounts
users.description: Identity accounts and their status. Search by the start of an address or a name.
users.name: Name
users.changed: The account status was changed and its sessions were revoked.
users.invalidTransition: That status change is not allowed from the current one.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A role is a named bundle of permissions. Protected system roles are fixed; custom roles are managed here.
roles.protectedNote: This role is migration-controlled. Its name and its permissions cannot be changed, and it cannot be deactivated.
roles.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It never changes.
roles.name: Name
roles.bundleUpdated: The permissions were saved, and everyone holding the role was signed out.
roles.deactivated2: The role was deactivated, and everyone holding it was signed out.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The permission catalogue. It is fixed by migration and cannot be changed at runtime; roles are where permissions are bundled.
permissions.unknown: This build does not describe this permission.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Which account holds which role, and the history of every grant and revoke.
assignments.grantAccountHelp: The internal identifier from the accounts list, not an address.
assignments.grantedMessage: The role was granted, and the account was signed out so the change takes effect.
assignments.alreadyHeld: That account already holds the role.
assignments.revokedMessage: The assignment was revoked, and the account was signed out.

security.title: Identity security
security.description: Privileged second-factor state and the status of the one-time administrator bootstrap. Read-only.
security.reenrolment: Re-enrolment required after an operator recovery
security.administrators: Accounts holding the Platform Administrator role
security.hostOnly: The bootstrap and the lockout recovery are host-only commands run by an operator against the database. They are not available from this or any other page, by design.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: The recorded history of security-relevant actions. Read-only, newest first.
audit.noPayload: Change payloads are recorded but not displayed here.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Outbound email provider configuration and status.
integrations.unavailable: Not configured — nothing is sent from this environment
integrations.webhookMissing: Signing secret absent — inbound events are refused
integrations.secretsNote: Credentials are never displayed here and cannot be edited from this page.

delivery.title: Mail delivery
delivery.description: Pending, failed and suppressed outbound mail. Recipients and message content are never recorded here.
delivery.retried: The delivery was put back on the schedule.
